title: Setup
subtitle: A few steps and your Minabox is ready.
close_confirm: Leave the wizard? You can start it again any time from the settings.

welcome.heading: Welcome to Minabox
welcome.body: This wizard walks you through the essentials: access protection, sound output, attached hardware and your first content.
welcome.duration: Takes about five minutes. Every step can be skipped.

security.heading: Access protection
security.intro: Without a password, any device on your home network can control the Minabox completely — including the media library and the parent dashboard.
security.too_short: The password must be at least four characters.
security.already_set: A password is already set. This step can be skipped.
security.skip_note: Without a password the Minabox stays open to everyone on the network.

audio.heading: Sound output
audio.intro: Pick the output and use the test tone to check that sound actually comes out.
audio.no_devices: No audio output was found. Check the wiring and whether the right driver is active.
audio.retry_hint: Then try a different output from the list.
audio.test_failed: The test tone could not be played.
audio.volume_hint: The maximum caps how loud the box can get at all.
audio.volume_order: Minimum, start value and maximum must be in that order.

hardware.heading: Attached hardware
hardware.intro: Only what actually responds here is wired up correctly.
hardware.none: No hardware components are active. This step can be skipped.
hardware.led_hint: The LED blinks for about five seconds.
hardware.buttons_hint: Press the buttons on the box one after another.
hardware.test_failed: The test failed. The component does not respond.

content.heading: First content
content.intro: Finally: teach the box a card and add some music.
content.card_waiting: Place a card or figure on the reader now …
content.card_next: Assigning it to a track happens afterwards under "Cards".
content.card_unavailable: The RFID service is not running.
content.media_hint: Music can be uploaded in the media library or fetched directly from a service.

done.heading: All set
done.restart_hint: You can start the wizard again any time from the settings.
